annotations.title: Restore a branch to a time

description: Rewind a branch in place to a point in time; the URL and keys stay and the state before is kept. Destructive: needs confirm: true and the destructive scope; production additionally needs production:destructive. Scope: branches:write.

at.description: RFC 3339 time inside the history window, e.g. 2026-09-28T10:15:00Z

confirm.description: Must be true to run a destructive operation, after the user approved it

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait until it is live (default 60, 0 returns immediately)

name: branches.restore
title: Restore a branch to a time
